text: Initiated modified FOLFIRINOX chemotherapy (reduced dose due to performance status and nutrition). Bilirubin improved to 1.8 mg/dL after stent placement. Baseline CA 19-9: 1250 U/mL. Pre-chemo assessment: ECOG 1, weight stabilized with nutritional support and pancreatic enzyme replacement. Port placed. Labs: WBC 5.2, Hgb 11.2, platelets 285k, creatinine 0.9. Patient counseled on side effects: fatigue, neuropathy, diarrhea, neutropenia risk. G-CSF support planned. Close monitoring for toxicity given advanced disease and borderline performance status. Palliative care team involved for symptom management and goals of care discussions.
